leavers.question: Count the employees whose Attrition is Yes. Return that number of leavers, not the attrition rate.
leavers.reference:
rates = df.groupby("OverTime")["Attrition"].apply(lambda s: (s == "Yes").mean())
gap = rates["Yes"] - rates["No"]

n_leavers = int((df["Attrition"] == "Yes").sum())

cases.input: An attrition rate of 0.1 among 100 employees.
cases.expect: The result is the absolute count of leavers, 10, not the rate.

quartile_gap.question: Compare attrition in income quartile Q4 with attrition in Q2. Return the Q4 rate minus the Q2 rate.
quartile_gap.reference:
df["IncomeQ"] = pd.qcut(df["MonthlyIncome"], 4, labels=["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"])

bq = df.groupby("IncomeQ", observed=True)["Attrition"].apply(lambda s: (s == "Yes").mean()).round(4)
qgap = round(bq["Q4"] - bq["Q2"], 4)

cases.expect: The gap is Q4 minus Q2, not the reverse.

cases.input: The two quartiles have the same attrition.
